fields.name: funds
fields.meaning: Low funds word in units of ten-thousands of yen; the high byte at SRAM 0x02DE contributes high*10000. Natural s202 low word is 320, displayed as 320万. Native clone tested 321 in the low word, displayed as 321万.
fields.evidence: Funds combine byte 0x02DE*10000 with u16le 0x02DF. Native natural 320 no-op control and 321 clone were accepted on the verified Continue route; both primary (0x02BE block) and backup (0x4000 block) copies changed their low word and had their source-defined checksums repaired. Reads at 4000:674F and 4000:9C16 observe 0x02DF; screenshots show 320万→321万. One-byte WRAM difference is 0x12A6, whose downstream role remains unnamed. Only this adjacent low-word change is tested; carry/boundary and payout/spend behavior are open.
